Bitcoin remains trapped near $63,500, explicitly decoupling from equities as the S&P 500 pushes toward new all-time highs. While legacy markets surged on yesterday's cooler-than-expected 4.7% Producer Price Index (PPI) print, digital asset allocators remain sidelined by regulatory opacity and industry restructuring.

The primary crypto catalyst vanished when the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) abruptly canceled today’s highly anticipated meeting on bespoke frameworks for crypto investment contracts. This delay extends compliance ambiguity for institutional funds. Concurrently, asset manager Bitwise executed a 14% headcount reduction, highlighting the operational friction currently facing native infrastructure providers.

Macroeconomic tailwinds are undeniably strong. The dovish inflation data effectively cements expectations for a Federal Reserve rate pause in September. However, until regulatory clarity allows institutional capital to confidently deploy, digital assets will likely continue to lag the broader equity market's risk-on rally.
